name: Social Democracy: Popular Front
summary:
France, 1936. In the wake of the far-right riots of February 1934, the left-of-center parties have united to form a Popular Front, against fascist threats to the Republic, and in defense of peace, bread, and liberty. You are the SFIO, the French Section of the Worker's International, the largest party in the Popular Front.

Can the Popular Front stay together despite the differing goals of its constituents? How will the ongoing economic crisis be addressed? And what of the rising aggression from Germany?
